name: v60_social_value_persistence_calm
hypothesis: The low-correlation social-value seed may need a longer persistence window and explicit sentiment calmness rather than more product/news/accounting support.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 180), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 180), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_std_dev(scl12_sentiment_fast_d1, 20), 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Repair of low-corr social seed 1Y7Z65JQ without debt/product/news/option parents.

name: v60_social_value_light_vwap_absorption
hypothesis: Social attention normalization may strengthen a light VWAP pressure signal while keeping the dominant exposure social rather than late-pressure technical.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.20 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 20)) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry)
notes: VWAP term is deliberately low weight; strict corr gate against mL86Jle1.

name: v60_social_bfl_profitability_confirm
hypothesis: Positive social value may matter more when low-coverage BFL profitability/growth scores confirm operating strength without using ordinary accounting yields.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_profitability + fscore_bfl_growth, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_90_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: Tests BFL scores as a low-weight confirmation rather than a product-peer main signal.

name: v60_news12_session_range_calm
hypothesis: Event-day session range and volume anomalies may identify overreaction pressure distinct from close-location/VWAP if converted from VECTOR to scalar first.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(session_range_standard_deviation), 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(trading_volume_standard_deviation_2), 90), industry) + 0.25 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(returns * (volume / adv20), 10)) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Uses vec_avg on news12 VECTOR fields to avoid event-input operator errors.

name: v60_news12_reaction_speed_calm
hypothesis: Slower event-day threshold moves plus lower range anomalies may capture calm price discovery rather than crowded news sentiment.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(minimum_minutes_to_one_percent_move), 90), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(main_minutes_to_one_pct_down_move), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(price_range_standard_deviation_2), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_60_days_spy, 90), industry)
notes: Different from RP product/business news: session reaction speed/volatility, not sentiment topic.

name: v60_fnd6_core_pension_relief
hypothesis: Low core pension and post-retirement adjustment burden may capture cleaner reported earnings without using deferred-tax or goodwill parents.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_pncwippq)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_pncwiaq)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_prcepsq)), 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_90_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: Low-alphaCount fundamental6 VECTOR fields; vec_avg required.

name: v60_fnd6_fair_value_hedge_clean
hypothesis: Lower fair-value changes and ineffective hedge gains/losses may proxy cleaner mark-to-market exposure without the v40 level-3 footnote warning path.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_tfvceq)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_hedgeglq)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_glpq)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Matrix/vector core-event version of fair-value cleanliness, kept away from ordinary debt/cashflow stabilizers.

name: v60_forward_intangible_amortization_light
hypothesis: Forward finite-lived intangible amortization may capture acquisition overhang more cleanly than historical goodwill growth or broad intangible burden.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * intangible_amortization_next_12m / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * annual_intangible_assets_net_carrying_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * finite_intangibles_gross_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Not a goodwill-growth rescue; no operating quality, reversal, graph, or deferred-tax terms.

name: v60_model16_bfl_total_calm
hypothesis: The low-usage BFL total/surface scores may be useful when treated as slow style quality and paired only with falling market-risk exposure.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_total, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_surface, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(fscore_bfl_profitability, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Direct BFL cold-score probe; not product-peer ranked and no news/option/graph stabilizer.

name: v60_model16_derivative_contrarian
hypothesis: Overheated model16 score derivatives may mean-revert when market-risk is falling; this tests a derivative contrarian sign away from analyst-revision fields.
expression: 0.35 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(multi_factor_static_score_derivative, 90)) + 0.25 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(growth_potential_rank_derivative, 90)) + 0.20 * rank(ts_rank(relative_valuation_rank_derivative, 90)) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: Different from v57 model16 revision inverse: uses several model16 derivative surfaces and no option/news/reversal terms.
